records.subject: You're in -- let's get Summit Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: One next step for Summit Analytics
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

You've got your first project created in Wrenfield, which is the main thing — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If anyone else at Summit Analytics will be working in there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next for your team and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Nadia
